name: Vivek Vishal
quote: I have known Parwez for quite long time now and in all of those years he has come across to me as one of the most hardworking and diligent people I know. But the best quality that I find in him is he helps others around him and make them grow alongside him. His ability to take control of his career and future and steer it forward with full control is also a very admirable and strong quality which is not very common. I am very certain that he would be a great asset to any organization he is part of.
